newsitem.title: UK: Soccer star Cantona in TV ad for iced tea.
newsitem.headline: Soccer star Cantona in TV ad for iced tea.

text.p: French soccer star Eric Cantona, the striker for England's Manchester United football club who has already appeared in advertisements for Eurostar and Nike, is starring in a new television ad for a sparkling iced tea, ad agency J. Walter Thompson said on Friday.
JWT, part of WPP Group Plc, said the television ad featuring Cantona for Liptonice sparkling iced tea will run in France, Belgium and Holland through the end of August.
The ad shows Cantona becoming hot and frustrated as he unsuccessfully tries his hand at golf. After drinking Liptonice he regains his composure and finally makes the perfect shot.
Liptonice is a product of Unilever
